function.name: Movies_1_BuyMovieTickets
function.description: Purchase tickets for a specific movie showing, including the number of tickets, show date and time, and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

movie_name.description: The title of the movie for which tickets are being purchased.

number_of_tickets.description: The total number of tickets to be bought.

show_date.description: The date on which the movie is showing, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

location.description: The city in which the movie theater is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Los Angeles, CA'.

show_time.description: The start time of the movie showing, in 24-hour format 'HH:MM'.

show_type.description: The format of the movie showing.

function.name: Movies_1_FindMovies
function.description: Search for movies based on location, genre, and show type at specific theaters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where the theatre is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'. State names must be abbreviated

theater_name.description: The name of the theatre. If unspecified, all theatres are considered.

genre.description: The genre of the movie. If unspecified, all genres are considered.

show_type.description: The type of movie show. If unspecified, all show types are considered.

function.name: Movies_1_GetTimesForMovie
function.description: Retrieves the show times for a specific movie at a particular theater location on a specified date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

movie_name.description: The title of the movie for which to find show times.

location.description: The city and state where the theater is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' and 'New York, NY'.

show_date.description: The date of the show in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', for example, '2023-04-15'.

theater_name.description: The name of the theater where the movie is showing. If not specified, any theater will be considered.

show_type.description: The format of the movie showing.
